## Implementation Report — round 3 (crash-fix: smoke p0prime closeness lacks parent clouds)

**Status:** READY-FOR-REVIEW

**Root cause.** Under `--smoke`, `main()` rebinds GEN/OUT/EVAL to `*_smoke` roots and `_fetch()` early-returns before the `clouds_parent` staging loop ("smoke mode -- skipping cache/cloud/mix downloads").
